author: Prairie State Wire
title: Western Springs announces outdoor watering restrictions for summer months
text:
The Village of Western Springs announced on May 20 that outdoor watering will be restricted between 11 a.m. and 5 p.m. from Memorial Day through Labor Day for both residents and businesses.
This restriction is intended to reduce strain on water production equipment and minimize wasteful evaporation during the hottest parts of the day. The village urges residents to adjust their irrigation timers accordingly to comply with these guidelines.
The announcement reminds, “Residents and businesses are reminded that outdoor watering may not take place between 11 am – 5 pm, from Memorial Day and through Labor Day. Watering earlier or later in the day helps reduce strain on water production equipment and prevents wasteful evaporation. Please adjust your irrigation timers with these restrictions in mind.”
Western Springs operates under a council-manager form of government, where professional staff deliver public services while supporting advisory boards made up of resident volunteers who address community issues and provide recommendations, according to the official website . The village manager supervises personnel and implements policies set by elected officials such as the village president and board of trustees, who serve as volunteers.
Village offices are located at 740 Hillgrove Avenue, according to the official website .
The broader impact of these restrictions is aimed at ensuring efficient use of local resources during peak summer demand periods while engaging community members in maintaining public services.
